title: Agentscrape corpus sample metadata
description: The `meta.json` beside a captured sample under `test/corpus/`: what the sample was captured from and what replaying it must produce.

version.description: Sample contract version. A sample declaring any other version is rejected rather than replayed.

preset.description: Preset that captured the sample. It must match the corpus directory the sample lives in.

mode.description: Extraction mode to replay. It must match the preset's mode in the registry.

url.description: Redacted URL the sample was captured from, replayed as the request URL.

expect.description: Whether replay must succeed and match the recorded output, or must raise the recorded failure.

structured.description: Structured payload the content-mode handler must return, compared as deeply equal. Absent means the payload is not asserted.

links.description: Links the `links` or `nav-links` replay must return, compared as deeply equal. Required for a successful sample in either mode.

failure.description: Failure a sample with `expect: failure` must raise.

type.description: Error class the replay must throw, matched with `instanceof`.

contains.description: Substring the thrown error's message must contain.

message_captured.description: Redacted message recorded when the sample was captured. It documents the capture and is not asserted.

assertions.description: Substring checks against the markdown a successful replay renders.

contains.description: Substrings the rendered markdown must contain.

not_contains.description: Substrings the rendered markdown must not contain.

category_pages.description: Captured second-level pages for a `nav-links` replay, one per section link followed.

section_url.description: Section link whose page this fixture stands in for.

page.description: Filename of the captured page, relative to the sample directory.
